question: Kati Bihu is celebrated in which of the following months in Assam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**October**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kati Bihu is celebrated in the month of **October**.
 
• It is one of the **three Bihu festivals** celebrated in Assam, the others being Rongali Bihu and Bhogali Bihu.
 
• Kati Bihu is also known as **Kongali Bihu**.
 
• This festival marks the **sowing season and the relocation of the rice saplings**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihu**

 
 
• Bihu is a set of three important Assamese festivals: Rongali or Bohag Bihu, Kati or Kongali Bihu, and Bhogali or Magh Bihu.
 
• Rongali Bihu marks the Assamese New Year and the arrival of Spring.
 
• Bhogali Bihu is a harvest festival, marking the end of the harvesting season.
 
• Kati Bihu is associated with the agrarian calendar and is observed with a sense of solemnity and simplicity.
 
 
 
• **Rongali Bihu**
 
 
• Also known as Bohag Bihu, celebrated in April.
 
• It is the most popular Bihu, marking the Assamese New Year.
 
• It is celebrated with feasts, music, and dance.
 
 
 
• **Bhogali Bihu**
 
 
• Also known as Magh Bihu, celebrated in January.
 
• It marks the end of the harvesting season.
 
• People celebrate with community feasts and bonfires.
